Get ready for the ultimate Bollywood drama at the ultimate Diwali Party—hitting Hartford on Nov 6th

About this Event

✨ Main Character Energy Activated: Hartford Is Getting Lit For Diwali ✨

No cap, the biggest night of the fall is officially locked in. We’re turning up for the Festival of Lights with a serious glow-up. Hartford Events LLC is hosting the ultimate Diwali Glow Party at The Lady on Friday, November 6th, 2026.

Whether you’re repping your roots in Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, or Telugu, or you just want to experience a high-key electric cultural rave, this multilingual extravaganza is going to be straight vibes.
 Bring the squad, stack your family in the group chat, and get ready for a night of pure euphoria, neon fits, and memories that will live rent-free in your mind forever.

🎧 The Lineup: DJ Ravlor x DJ MavinThe wait is officially over and the lineup is certified elite. Taking over the decks is DJ Ravlor, dropping heavy-hitting anthems all night long. Setting the vibe and opening up the floor is DJ Mavin. Prepare for absolute non-stop bangers spanning Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, and Telugu beats. The energy is going to be unmatched—make sure your phone is charged because this night is going to be movie-status.

📍 The Venue: The Lady
We’re taking over Hartford’s premier spot—The Lady (191 Ann Uccello St).
 It’s right in the center of the city, perfectly safe, highly aesthetic, and has zero-hassle parking and transit access.

🎟️ Secure Your Spot
Do not sleep on this. General admission tickets are an absolute steal for an all-night pass to the most vibrant Diwali party in Connecticut. 

Tickets are heavily limited, so lock yours in early and prepare to absolutely glow.
